notes.en: Deployment: the code hash is the Type ID script hash; type-id args come from dotbitHQ/das-lib core/env.go (mainnet 0x108fba6a…, testnet Testnet2 0xd7b9d821…); live code cells and txs seen on both networks.

notes.zh: 这个 type 不检查 lock 以外的签名：IncomeCell 用 always-success lock，规则全部在 type 里。
notes.en: This type does not check signatures: IncomeCells use the always-success lock, so all rules live in the type.

notes.zh: 大部分规则依赖 IncomeCell witness 的 molecule 记录和 cell_deps 里的 ConfigCellIncome / ConfigCellProfitRate；解码器不加载 cell_deps 数据，本插件也不解码 IncomeCell witness，所以这些项显示为未检查。
notes.en: Most rules depend on the molecule records in IncomeCell witnesses and on ConfigCellIncome / ConfigCellProfitRate in cell_deps; the decoder does not load cell_dep data and this plugin does not decode IncomeCell witnesses, so those items show as not checked.

notes.zh: Type ID 合约可升级；所读源码 0cc9fbf 官方注明从最新部署合约同步，未做可复现构建。
notes.en: Type ID contracts are upgradable; the source read (0cc9fbf) is officially described as synced from the latest deployed contracts; no reproducible build.
